basic_details.job_title: BITS Pilani PhD Position (Physics) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Birla Institute of Technology & Science, Pilani, K K Birla Goa Campus has one fully funded PhD position under the BITS Pilani-IIT Madras collaborative Ph.D. program. Candidates send their CV by email to Prof. Sanjib Dey at [email protected] by 21 November 2026. The fellowship is ₹37,000 + 30% HRA = ₹48100 per month, with an annual contingency of ₹20,000.

PhD Position (project: Resource-efficient generation of GKP states for photonic quantum Technologies)
M.Sc. in Physics or an equivalent degree, with minimum 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA
K K Birla Goa Campus, Zuarinagar, South Goa; part of the programme at IIT Madras
21 November 2026 (notice says CV to be sent "by 21st Nov, 2026")

content_sections.heading: About BITS Pilani Goa Campus and the Project
content_sections.text: BITS Pilani (Deemed to be University) runs its K K Birla Goa Campus at NH-17B, Zuarinagar, South Goa. The position sits in a project to develop and optimize practical methods for generating high-quality Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) states in photonic quantum computing. The work accounts for realistic experimental imperfections, resource constraints and their impact on fault-tolerant quantum information processing. The supervisor is Prof. Sanjib Dey of BITS Pilani and the co-supervisor is Prof. Anil Prabhakar of IIT Madras. The notice is dated 07/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send your CV to Prof. Sanjib Dey at [email protected] by 21st Nov, 2026. Only candidates meeting the stated qualification should apply. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for online interviews, and the interview schedule will be sent to them by email. Queries about the position can be emailed to the same address. The notice does not print an email subject line.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: M.Sc. in Physics or an equivalent degree in Physics / Engineering Physics / M.Tech. / M.E. / B.E. / B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering or other allied disciplines from a recognized university / Institute, with minimum 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA. Desired skills: knowledge of quantum mechanics, quantum optics or quantum information theory, along with basic programming skills (preferably Python) and an interest in theoretical and numerical research. Age limit: 28 Yrs. The notice prints no cut-off date for age and no relaxation. Annual contingency: ₹ 20,000/-. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for a fully funded PhD position under the BITS Pilani-IIT Madras collaborative Ph.D. program.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani PhD position?
faq.answer: The CV must be sent by 21 November 2026 to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the BITS Pilani PhD position?
faq.answer: M.Sc. in Physics or an equivalent degree in Physics / Engineering Physics / M.Tech. / M.E. / B.E. / B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering or other allied disciplines from a recognized university / Institute, with minimum 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice gives the age limit as 28 Yrs.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: The fellowship is ₹ 37,000 + 30% HRA = ₹ 48100 per month, plus an annual contingency of ₹ 20,000.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the ₹37,000?
faq.answer: The notice prints the fellowship as ₹ 37,000 + 30% HRA = ₹ 48100 per month, so the HRA is part of the ₹48,100 figure.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send your CV by email to Prof. Sanjib Dey at [email protected] by 21st Nov, 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates are called for online interviews, with the schedule sent by email. Selected candidates are registered for the Ph.D. program subject to the Ph.D. qualification process as per academic guidelines of BITS Pilani.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Will the student have to stay at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: Yes, for part of the programme. The student is expected to spend at least 6 months at IIT Madras, which could be extended up to 24 months, as decided by the supervisor and co-supervisor.
